reviews.text: había probado limpiador en aceite y ahora me atrevi a usar este en balsamo superando todas mis expectativas . se fundió en mi piel de una forma extra suave y deliciosa. amé su textura , sin aroma ( me hubiese gustado un aroma suave ) . lo volvería a comprar .
reviews.zh: 之前試過卸妝油，而家我大膽試吓呢款潔面膏，超越咗我所有期望。佢喺我皮膚上融化，感覺超級柔和、好舒服。我好鍾意佢嘅質地，無味（我本來希望有少少柔和嘅香味）。我會再買。

reviews.text: Very very nice cleansing balm! cleans perfectly the skin and heavy make-up! I masaged into the skin for 2 minutes and it melt the impurities from the pores pretty good. it’s not drying out the skin so after face washing you still have the feeling of well hydrated skin. there’s only one thing that I liked less, it’s the smell but, I understand that it is the smell from the oil together with the warmth of the skin. Overall, I love it and highly recommend
reviews.zh: 非常好用嘅潔面膏！可以完美清潔皮膚同濃妝！我將佢按摩喺皮膚上兩分鐘，佢就好有效咁溶解毛孔入面嘅污垢。佢唔會令皮膚乾燥，所以洗完面之後，你仍然會有皮膚水潤嘅感覺。只有一樣我唔太鍾意，就係氣味，不過我明白呢個係油同皮膚溫度一齊產生嘅味道。總括嚟講，我好鍾意，極力推薦。

reviews.text: A nice cleansing balm overall. It removes sunscreen and makeup well, rinses off easily, and leaves my skin feeling comfortable without drying it out. It has a slight natural scent from the ingredients, but it’s mild and doesn’t bother me. Overall, it’s a good product that does the job, but I’ve tried other cleansing balms that I liked more and found more effective, so I’m not sure I would repurchase it.
reviews.zh: 整體上係一款不錯嘅潔面膏。佢可以好好咁卸走防曬同化妝，容易沖洗，洗完皮膚感覺舒服，唔會乾燥。佢有少少天然成分嘅氣味，但好溫和，唔會令我反感。總括嚟講，係一款有效、做得到嘢嘅產品，不過我試過其他我更鍾意、更有效嘅潔面膏，所以未必會再買。

reviews.text: Appositamente formulato per la pelle sensibile, questo balsamo detergente a base di olio di avocado rimuove facilmente impurità, trucco e prodotti solari, donando alla pelle una sensazione di freschezza e luminosità senza irritazioni né sensazione di tensione.
reviews.zh: 專為敏感皮膚而調配，呢款以牛油果油為基礎嘅潔面膏，可以輕鬆去除污垢、化妝同防曬產品，令皮膚感覺清新、有光澤，又冇刺激或者緊繃感。

reviews.text: Probé este balsamo y noté que retira muy bien el maquillaje y las impurezas sin dejar la piel seca. Se derrite fácilmente y deja el rostro limpio, suave y con una sensación hidratada. Me gustó que no irrita ni deja residuos grasos. Es una buena opción para la limpieza diaria, sobre todo si buscas algo suave pero efectivo, lo usé en la noche
reviews.zh: 我試咗呢款潔面膏，發現佢可以好好地卸走化妝同污垢，而且唔會令皮膚乾燥。佢容易溶化，洗完臉部乾淨、柔滑，有水潤感。我最鍾意佢唔會刺激，亦唔會留低油膩殘留。日常潔面都好好，特別係如果你想要溫和但有效嘅產品。我係夜晚用嘅。

reviews.text: Me encanta cómo este bálsamo se derrite en la piel al aplicarlo. Remueve maquillaje y protector solar sin esfuerzo y deja mi rostro limpio, suave y sin sensación grasosa. Siento la piel hidratada y tersa después de usarlo y no me irrita los ojos ni la piel.
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢款潔面膏喺皮膚上融化嘅感覺。佢可以輕鬆卸走化妝同防曬，令我張面乾淨、柔滑，而且冇油膩感。用完之後皮膚感覺水潤緊緻，亦唔會刺激我嘅眼睛同皮膚。

reviews.text: it was lovely but I do prefer the beauty of joseon one.It smells like olive oil which I like and it removes the make up but I find myself to prefer others more.I don’t know if I would repurchase it,I love that it has zero fragrance to it though!!!
reviews.zh: 呢款都幾好，但係我更鍾意 beauty of joseon 嗰款。佢有啲似橄欖油嘅味道，我都幾鍾意，又可以卸妝，不過我發覺自己更偏好其他款。我唔知會唔會回購，不過我好鍾意佢完全冇香味！！！
